subphase: Batch 4: password KDFs (PBKDF2, scrypt, PKCS12, PBKDF1, PVK) and KDF test isolation

candidate.scope: provider/kdf.rs password KDFs (24 sites) and the module's test isolation

stop_status: NO PRODUCT DEFECT REMAINING IN THE REVIEWED SCOPE. One genuine out-of-bounds defect (PBKDF2 int truncation) was fixed, two compatibility divergences were documented, and a stochastic gate was root-caused to missing test isolation rather than a race. The re-review of the isolation fix is NOT_RUN by owner instruction; the batch is recorded at BATCH evidence, not independently checked.

authority.abi: No C ABI change; no #[repr(C)], exported symbol, extern "C" signature, seam constant or lint attribute changed.
authority_behaviour: pbkdf2.c:617 tkeylen=(int)keylen; cplen int; for keylen in [2^31, 2^32) the value is negative and the copy/index is OOB (UB).
PBKDF2 passlen > i32::MAX is refused by HMAC_Init_ex (len < 0).
scrypt.c casts all three lengths to int; INT_MAX+1 fails in the authority, but k*2^32+r can succeed with truncated semantics.

boundaries.before: keylen was copied into an int, so keylen > i32::MAX became negative and the byte count derived from it was enormous (reachable OOB via EVP_KDF_derive with a 2 GiB key length).
boundaries.after: The loop is widened to usize; for keylen <= i32::MAX the sequence is bit-identical.
boundaries.mechanism: ELIMINATED: a negative byte count derived from a truncated length is no longer expressible.
boundaries.state: FIXED (author) + INDEPENDENTLY CHECKED (reviewer, round 1 of B4)

boundaries.before: Lengths narrowed at the HMAC boundary; passlen/saltlen/keylen above i32::MAX truncated.
boundaries.after: Refused before allocating, with the module's error reason. Divergence set: PBKDF2 refuses passlen > i32::MAX and salt_len > i32::MAX (guard moved before the cast, so the previously truncated k*2^32+r half is now refused); scrypt refuses passlen/saltlen/keylen > i32::MAX.
boundaries.mechanism: ELIMINATED: a truncated length cannot reach a copy or index.
boundaries.state: FIXED (author) + independently reviewed in round 1; the salt_len guard move is author-evidenced only (re-review NOT_RUN)

boundaries.file: src/provider/kdf.rs PKCS12KDF sizing; PBKDF2 stack digest
boundaries.before: Sizing products unchecked; the derived stack digest survived the call.
boundaries.after: checked_mul/checked_add throughout; the digest is cleansed on exit (unobservable).
boundaries.mechanism: RELOCATED to checked arithmetic; residue eliminated.

boundaries.operation: test isolation on shared cached methods
boundaries.before: Five routine tests fetched or freed the shared default-libctx method without holding the global-state lock, so another test's legitimate +/-1 on the cached refcount made the scrypt assertion fail intermittently (2/20 module runs).
boundaries.after: All five take lock_global_state; the scrypt assertion is relative (after == before) and still fails on a leaked up-ref.
boundaries.mechanism: ELIMINATED: a gate whose result depended on test interleaving.
boundaries.state: FIXED (author); re-review NOT_RUN (owner instruction); author evidence 20/20 module and 5/5 full-suite runs green

The owner directed that verification stop and the release proceed. The author's determinism evidence (20/20, 5/5) is recorded as author evidence only, not as independent review.
